rancho: Rancho San Bernardo (Snook grant), San Diego County, California
disambiguation: This is the SAN DIEGO COUNTY Rancho San Bernardo granted 1842/1845 to Jose Francisco (Joseph) Snook, between present-day Escondido and Poway (encompassing present-day Rancho Bernardo, 4S Ranch, San Pasqual Valley, Lake Hodges). It is DIFFERENT land from Rancho San Bernardo (Soberanes) in Monterey County and Rancho San Bernardo (Canet) in San Luis Obispo County. The Osuna family named in the task brief is NOT documented as an owner of this rancho; the Osunas are tied to Rancho San Dieguito / Rancho Santa Fe (different San Diego County land). Snook's widow/claimant was Maria Antonia Alvarado de Snook. Sikes = Zenas Sikes, who bought a 2,400-acre portion of the former rancho in 1868.

Osuna family: NO documented ownership link to Rancho San Bernardo (Snook) found. The Osunas (Juan Maria / Leandro Osuna) are tied to Rancho San Dieguito / Rancho Santa Fe -- DIFFERENT San Diego County land. LOC HABS 'Leandro Osuna House, Via de Santa Fe, Rancho Santa Fe' (item ca1718) depicts that other rancho and was excluded as not this land.
